name: Catch'em copy rules: advice phrases
about: The one shared list. Catchem-data builds, catchem-site and catchem-bot all read this file. The site and bot keep a byte-for-byte copy and a test fails when the copy drifts from Catchem-data main. Patterns are case-insensitive and use only syntax that JavaScript and Python read the same way. A match flags the line with its reason. Nothing is rewritten.

rules.pattern: \b(buy|sell|grab|dump) (it |them |this |these |one )?(now|today|right now|before it's gone|before its gone)\b|\b(now is the|good|great|best) time to (buy|sell)\b|\btime to (buy|sell)\b
rules.reason: Tells people to buy or sell now. Say what the price did instead.

rules.pattern: \byou (should|need to|have to|must|gotta|ought to) (buy|sell|hold|grab|dump|flip|invest|pick up|get in|get out|load up)\b
rules.reason: Tells people what to do with their money. Describe the listings and prices instead.
Tells people to buy a lot. Say what changed instead.
Promises a result. Prices can always move either way.
Promises a result. Prices can always move either way.
Hype that promises a climb. Say the real change and dates instead.
Crypto words are kept out of Catch'em copy.
No em or en dashes in copy. Use a comma or a period.
